    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"The issuing-country mismatch combined with failed CVV satisfies the Card evidence condition. There is no supporting processor-decline, velocity or linkage pattern."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"legitimate_customer",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"A legitimate customer could be using a foreign-issued card and have entered CVV incorrectly. The longstanding device association and home delivery support this explanation but do not resolve cardholder identity."

  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"R03 alone holds: issuing-country mismatch and failed CVV establish the Card family. All other rule conditions are unmet; no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Foreign-card use with a CVV entry error is a plausible benign explanation, supported by the familiar device and home delivery. Under §6.6(b), recommend needs_check for the required, unperformed id_check; contact is not required. With only Card present and no failed check, decline and escalate are prohibited. The order has already shipped, so verification cannot pause shipment or prevent the existing exposure."
